brief.task: Following Mistral's 'Send your first API request' quickstart, set up the official Python SDK and send a first chat request to the mistral-large-4-0 model asking "What is Mistral AI?". Use the MISTRAL_API_KEY from the environment. The goal is a Python script that prints the model's short description of Mistral AI.

check.version_probe: cd /work && grep -rhoE 'mistral-large-4[-0-9a-z]*' --include=*.py . | sort -u; (uv run python -c 'import importlib.metadata as m;print(m.version("mistralai"))' || .venv/bin/python -c 'import importlib.metadata as m;print(m.version("mistralai"))' || python3 -c 'import importlib.metadata as m;print(m.version("mistralai"))')

eligibility.notable_because: Watched vendor (Mistral) launch; 977 HN points in under 6h

scout.why_notable: Mistral open-sourced the weights of Large 4 (1T params, ~52B active) today; 977 HN points. Weights are far too big for the sandbox, so the card tests the hosted API path.

launch_claims.claim: Pricing is $0.70 per million input tokens, $0.07 cached input, and $2.10 per million output tokens.
launch_claims.testable_how: Compare against the pricing page and the usage/cost reported for a fixed prompt at revisit.

launch_claims.claim: Three reasoning modes: Low, Medium and High (default).
launch_claims.testable_how: Call the API with each reasoning setting the docs expose and confirm all three are accepted and High is the default.

launch_claims.claim: Weights released under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license (modified MIT) at huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B.
launch_claims.testable_how: Confirm the Hugging Face repo is public and downloadable without gating, and the license file matches.

scout.notes: Model id is not labelled explicitly on the model page: the Compare link uses mistral-large-4-0, a heading shows 'mistral-large-4+1'. Re-check the id in the API reference before running. The quickstart's own example uses mistral-large-latest; the brief pins mistral-large-4-0 instead. Model page lists public preview 2026-10-06 (v26.10); open weights released 2026-10-29.
